about_page.title: An agency built for brands that sell desire.
about_page.sub: Born from the industry. Grown with it.
about_page.story: Explore Digital was born from the conviction that hospitality and experience brands deserve an agency that truly understands the industry, not one that just applies generic templates. We built our expertise within the universe that demands identity, emotion, and desire.
about_page.story2: We work along the coast of Ceará and Rio Grande do Norte: Preá, Ilha do Guajirú and Pipa. We work in Portuguese, English and Spanish, because much of the guest and owner base on this coast comes from abroad.
about_page.v1_desc: We only work with hospitality on the coast of Ceará and Rio Grande do Norte. That makes us better at what matters most to you.
about_page.v2_desc: We don't sell impressions. We sell direct bookings, qualified leads, and real measurable growth.
about_page.v3_desc: You know what's being done, why, and what results it's generating. Always, no asterisks.

about_page.estudio_title: We did not learn tourism in a classroom.
about_page.estudio_destaque: We ran a hostel, a guesthouse and a kite school
about_page.estudio_p1: Before Explore Digital existed, this team had already dealt with empty rooms in the low season, a guest complaining about breakfast, and an OTA taking a quarter of every booking. We did not study the problem, we lived in it.
about_page.estudio_p2: That is why the conversation starts with occupancy and direct bookings, not reach and engagement. Anyone who has run the operation knows which number pays the bills.

consultoria.faq_title: What people ask before booking a session.

faq_items.q: Is it really free? Where’s the catch?
faq_items.a: There isn’t one. We don’t ask for a card and we don’t charge afterwards. Some of the people we meet become clients, the rest refer us. Both are worth it.
45 minutes, by video call or WhatsApp, on the day and time you choose.

faq_items.q: Do I need an ad budget already?
faq_items.a: No. The X-ray points to positioning, content and conversion fixes that don’t depend on paid media.

faq_items.q: My inn is small. Is it worth it?
faq_items.a: Yes, and usually more so. The smaller the operation, the more each direct booking weighs. We’ve worked with everything from eight-room inns to resorts.
Yes. We’ve worked with brands in three countries, in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

faq_items.q: What if I don’t want to hire anyone?
faq_items.a: Nothing happens. The X-ray is yours and you run it in-house or with another partner.
